newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA TO DOMINATE, THIN HELSINKI AWAITS MOTOROLA Q2.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA TO DOMINATE, THIN HELSINKI AWAITS MOTOROLA Q2.

text.p: sideways with the focus on Nokia on Tuesday, ahead of Motorola's
second quarter report due after NYSE close, brokers said.
Trade was seen thin with the only obvious interest in
speculative trades ahead of Motorola's report, which is expected
to show a slight improvement on the first quarter's $0.53 per
share earnings and last year's $0.54 per share.
Nokia closed at $77-3/4 in New York, the equivalent of about
406 markka, compared to its 407.50 Helsinki close.
"This will be quite Nokia centered today," one broker said.
